fol.notes: Pulsars are an enumeration (quenmarra_pulsar stands for the known Quenmarra pulsars, other_pulsar for any other pulsar); qp3 and qp7 are constants of that sort. The edit adds the rule and that Quenmarra pulsars are now known (the record's w2). Which pulsars compete for the record is a presupposition (every other known pulsar is slower). w1 stores the record holder by name; w2 stores the rule that reads it off the rates. A rotation period is 1 / rate (firm arithmetic in the query).

j1748_rate.says: PSR J1748−2446ad is a known pulsar that spins about 716 times per second. (stored)

pulsars_in_running.says: The known pulsars in the running for the fastest are PSR J1748−2446ad and any Quenmarra pulsars; every other one is slower. (closed world)
